mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, abnormal_id, product_id, product_type, quantity, report_id, type, user_id

choose.when: SELECT a.id, c.user_name, a.quantity, date(b.create_time) complete_time, b.process_id, date(task.ask_complete_time) ask_complete_time, a.report_type, process.`name` process_name, factory.id 'factory.id', factory.`name` 'factory.name', workshop.id 'workshop.id', workshop.`name` 'workshop.name', production_line.id 'production_line.id', production_line.`name` 'production_line.name' FROM mes_building_abnormal_report a LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_team_report b ON a.report_id = b.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_task task ON b.task_id=task.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process process ON b.process_id = process.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link c ON b.team_id = c.team_id AND c.bool_leader_enum = 1 AND c.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory factory ON factory.id=task.factory_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON workshop.id=task.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line production_line ON production_line.id=task.production_line_id WHERE a.abnormal_id=#{abnormalId} AND a.bool_delete_enum=0
choose.otherwise: SELECT a.id, a.quantity, date(task.ask_complete_time) ask_complete_time, factory.id, factory.`name`, workshop.id, workshop.`name`, production_line.id, production_line.`name` FROM mes_building_abnormal_report a LEFT JOIN mes_building_task task ON a.report_id=task.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory factory ON factory.id=task.factory_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON workshop.id=task.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line production_line ON production_line.id=task.production_line_id WHERE a.abnormal_id =#{abnormalId} AND a.bool_delete_enum = 0
